title: Why Is There a Spider Web on a Steelpan?

voice_performance.performance_intent: Plain-spoken, a little sly, like letting someone in on something. Land 'the opposite' and 'sings instead of rattling'. Ease off, warm, for the closing line.
voice_performance.energy_curve: flat curious open, tighten through the middle, small lift on 'sings', settle for the name
voice_performance.pause_policy: Beat after 'looks random.' Beat before 'and the whole pan buzzes.' Beat before 'That's the trick.'

provider_notes.kokoro: bm_george or am_michael. No fake Trinidadian accent.

sections.label: Hook
sections.text: This pattern on a steel pan looks random. It's the opposite.
sections.speaker_directions: Sly. Full stop and beat after 'random'.

enhancement_cues.description: Real hammered-metal disc backdrop; the vector web + note dots snap into focus over it
'looks random' struck through, 'the opposite' punches in

sections.label: Setup - one sheet of steel
sections.text: Every note is on the same sheet of metal. Put two clashing notes side by side, and the whole pan buzzes.
sections.speaker_directions: Matter-of-fact. Beat before 'and the whole pan buzzes'.

enhancement_cues.description: Two dots flare red, adjacent, and visibly rattle; faint distortion on the bed under 'buzzes'

sections.label: Build - the layout fixes it
sections.text: The layout fixes that. Clashing notes go to opposite sides. Friendly notes stay close.

enhancement_cues.description: Red dots slide to opposite edges and calm; two dots glow warm and snap together

sections.label: Payoff
sections.text: That's the trick. It's why a steel pan sings instead of rattling.
sections.speaker_directions: Small lift on 'sings'. Let it land.

enhancement_cues.description: Whole pan pulses warm once; bed brightens briefly

sections.label: Landing - Williams + end tag
sections.text: A Trinidadian tuner named Anthony Williams worked it out in 1953. Every lead pan in the world is still built from his map.
sections.speaker_directions: Warm, proud, unhurried. Down on 'his map'.

enhancement_cues.description: Web pattern multiplies small across a faint world map
End tag on the final frame

guardrail_checks.contested_credit_stated_as_fact: pass - credits Williams with the LAYOUT (well established), not the contested oil-drum credit
guardrail_checks.on_screen_assets: pass - vector diagram + type + non-figurative AI texture/atmosphere only; no archival photos, no depiction of Williams, no AI-generated 'accurate' or historical pan presented as real

metadata.review_flag: 1953 is secondary-sourced; confirm with a pan source before publishing or soften to 'the early 1950s'.
metadata.wording_note: Reworked from the first draft for spoken rhythm and mass appeal: shorter sentences, 'sings instead of rattling', 'friendly notes', 'built from his map' callback to the hook.
